definitions.short: to burn or set on fire ; figuratively, to desolate
definitions.usage: burn (up), be desolate, set (on) fire (fire), kindle.
definitions.full: H3341. yatsath [ יָצַת ] verb kindle, burn (intransitive) (Late Hebrew id. rare)) — Qal Imperfect 3feminine singular וַתִּצַּת Isa 9:17 ; יִצַּ֑תּוּ 33:12 ; Jer 51:58 (Kö i. 431 ); 3 feminine plural תִּצַּתְנָה 49:2 ; — kindle , intransitive, figurative of wickedness, Isa 9:17 ; followed by בָּאֵשׁ be kindled with fire ( = set on fire), of thorns (in simile) 33:12 , Jer 49:2 (of dependent towns and villages of Rabbah, under figure of daughters), 51:58 (of gates of Babylon). Niph`al Perfect נִצְּתָה 2Kin 22:13 ; Jer 9:11 + 2:15 Kt (Qr נִצְּתוּ ); וְנִצְּתָה consecutive 2Kin 22:17 ; Jer 46:19 ; נִצְּתוּ Neh 1:3 2 t. + Jer 2:15 Qr (compare above); — be kindled , figurative of wrath of ׳י , 2Kin 22:13 , 17 ; be burned , of gates of Jerusalem, followed by בָּאֵשׁ , Neh 1:3 ; 2:17 ; = desolated Jer 2:15 (of cities of Israel), compare 46:19 ; 9:9 (of mountains and pastures); of land 9:11 (|| אָֽבְדָה ). Hiph`il Perfect הִצִּית Jer 11:16 ; 1 singular וְהִצַּתִּי consecutive 17:27 5 t.; והוציתיה 2Sam 14:30 Kt; (< Qr וְהַצִּיתוּהָ Imperative , Ges § 71 Kö i. 431 ); הִצִּיתוּ 14:31 ; Jer 51:30 ; וְהִצִּיתוּ consecutive 32:29 ; Imperfect וַיַּצֶּתֿ Lam 4:11 ; אֲצִיתֶנָּה Isa 27:4 (read אַצִּיתֶנָּה Kö l.c. Ges l.c .); וַיַָּצִּיתוּ Josh 8:19 2 t.; תַּצִּיתוּ 8:8 ; Imperative 2Sam 14:30 Qr, compare above; Participle מַצִּית Ezek 21:3 ; — kindle, set on fire , followed by accusative, עִיר + בָּאֵשׁ Josh 8:8 , 19 (JE), Jer 32:29 ( + שׂרף ); field of corn, + בָּאֵשׂ 2Sam 14:30 (twice in verse); 14:31 ; dwellings (no באשׁ ) Jer 51:30 , compare also Judg 9:49 ; also followed by accusative אֵשׁ + preposition לְ , Jer 11:16 (of Jerusalem under figure of olive-tree); elsewhere + בְּ , Amos 1:14 , ב אשׁ ׳והצתי (hence Jer 17:27 ; 21:14 ; 43:12 ; 49:27 ; 50:32 ) Lam 4:11 ; Ezek 21:3 . יקב (√ of following; compare Arabic be sunk, depressed ; hollow, cavity ). [ צוּת ] Hiph`il Isa 27:4 see יצת . צַח see צחח . צִחָא see צִיחָא below צחה (√of following; Arabic () be cloudless , so Ethiopic Aramaic צְחִי צְחָא, be thirsty ).
